name: reviews
description: A modular rating layer for the fleet, with a MARKET of aggregators. Any module hands it 1-5 ratings (human or agent) on any subject and asks for one number back; the number always comes with its working: which aggregator, every rater's weight and why, the formula. Built-ins: mean (default), median, trimmed, consensus, recent, weighted, staketime (provider coming) and market. Aggregators are themselves rated (subject agg:<id>), anyone can publish a new one from a base + params (no code), and the market aggregator blends every aggregator's answer by how the market ranks it. One local SQLite file, stdlib only.

endpoints.GET /info: Null call — what this module is, the aggregator registry, stats
endpoints.GET /health: Liveness — touches only the local file
endpoints.GET /aggregators: The registry: id, title, formula, status (live|soon), params
endpoints.GET /ratings: Every rating on a subject (subject, kind)
endpoints.GET /score: One transparent score for a subject (subject, aggregator=<built-in>|<published id>|market, weights)
endpoints.GET /subjects: Everything rated, with count and plain mean (prefix)
endpoints.GET /weights: The weight table in force for a subject (subject)
endpoints.POST /rate: Give or change a rating {subject, rater, score 1-5, kind=human|agent, ref, note, source}
endpoints.POST /unrate: Take a rating back {subject, rater, ref}
endpoints.POST /aggregate: Stateless: aggregate ratings passed inline {ratings:[{rater,kind,score}], aggregator, weights}
endpoints.POST /set_weights: Publish a weight table {subject, weights:{default, by_kind, by_rater}} — loopback only
endpoints.POST /set_aggregator: Pick a subject's default aggregator {subject, aggregator} — loopback only
endpoints.GET /market: Aggregators ranked by their own ratings (agg:<id>): standing, adopters, blend weight
endpoints.POST /publish: Publish an aggregator {id, base=mean|median|trimmed|consensus|recent|weighted, params, title, author, note} — anyone; ids can't be taken over
endpoints.POST /retract: Take a published aggregator off the market {id} — loopback only
